messages:
maya: quick heads-up — while reviewing last night's KMS rewrap I found a handful of long-lived Vault tokens that never rotated. Limited scope (staging + one partner sandbox) but we should treat it as an incident and rotate.

darin: ok. do we know which mint flow issued them — app service or legacy CI?

maya: they appear to be minted by svc-deployer-legacy, from an old deployer job that never picked up the new wrapping key. Audit shows unwrap errors but tokens remained accepted.

harry: can you paste the relevant audit lines (TTL + policies)?

maya: snippet from audit: 

```
2026-03-19T02:14:33Z auth.token: method=login token_id=tdZq4... user=svc-deployer-legacy ttl=31536000 policies=[deploy write_kv staging] result=success
2026-03-19T02:14:33Z responseWrap: wrapping_key=old-kms-ciphertext unwrap_result=ERR_KEY_NOT_FOUND
```

jen: unwrap failed but token issuance still shows success — sounds like tokens minted prior to the key swap are still valid.

darin: this is high priority. Immediate actions: revoke outstanding tokens, block further long-ttl mints, rotate secrets those tokens could access, and rewrap any transit keys used by the flow. How many affected?

maya: small batch: 6 tokens spanning 3 namespaces (staging, partner-sandbox, dev-int), all tied to svc-deployer-legacy.

opsbot: automated-scan: found 6 tokens >7d TTL issued before 2026-03-18. Report: https://internal/reports/token-audit/4273

harry: proposed runbook: 
- revoke the six tokens now
- apply a temporary Vault deny policy to stop auth/token/create for that role
- rotate the KV mounts used by the service
- rewrap the transit key used by the deployer pipeline
- increase audit retention and tag events with incident ID

jen: +1. Also push an org-wide short note discouraging custom long-ttl mint flows until we have tests/guards.

maya: I'll take token revocation + deny policy. darin, can you own KV rotations? harry, you own the deployer hotfix to ensure it uses the current wrapping key and a safe TTL cap.

darin: list the affected mounts please.

maya: mounts: secret/data/apps/staging/, secret/data/partners/*/deploy, transit/deployer-key (used for repo-local encrypt).

darin: starting KV rotation and transit rewrap now. ETA ~90 minutes; will update thread when complete.

harry: working on hotfix: switch to current KMS key and enforce TTL cap of 1 hour for minted tokens. PR ready in ~20m.

jen: enable the audit sink to Splunk with incident tag INC-2026-0034, raise an alert for any token.create with TTL > 3600s, and extend retention for 14 days for deployer paths.

maya: executing revokes and temporary deny policy now.

```
# vault token revoke tdZq4...
# vault token revoke tdA1b...
# vault policy write deny-long-ttl - <<EOF
path "auth/token/create" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```

opsbot: action recorded: maya revoked 6 tokens. Incident created INC-2026-0034. https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-0034

darin: KV rotation in progress: re-encrypting KV paths and updating CI consumers to pick up new creds. Will restart affected services.

maya: harry, once your hotfix is in, canary-deploy and watch the token audit for any new long-ttl token creations.

harry: will run a canary deploy to staging and attach an alert for token.create TTL > 1h.

jen: notify partner owners for the sandbox; lower blast radius but still rotate and confirm CI changes. Use partner notification template.

opsbot: partner notification sent to partner-security@list. Incident ID INC-2026-0034.

darin: KV rotations complete. Applications pulled new secrets and restarted; no auth failures observed.

maya: revoke + deny applied; audit sink and alerts enabled; hotfix merged and promoted to staging; saw expected alert during canary then cleared. No further long-ttl tokens observed.

jen: moving incident to monitoring phase. Keep elevated audit and retention for 14 days and leave alerts active.

maya: postmortem notes: root cause = legacy custom token mint flow didn't handle KMS key rollover; missing test coverage for unwrap/rewrap logic; action items = add unit + integration tests for wrapping key rotation, add TTL cap at issuer, and add e2e for deployer job. I'll draft the postmortem and assign owners.

harry: I'll add TTL guard and tests in the deployer repo (owner: eng-deploy) and link PR in the postmortem.

darin: I'll verify rotations in prod CI tomorrow to ensure no residual tokens.

maya: final checklist:
- [x] revoke 6 tokens
- [x] deny issuance policy applied
- [x] KV mounts rotated
- [x] transit key rewrapped
- [x] hotfix deployed
- [x] audit retention extended & alerts
- [x] partner notifications sent

jen: thanks team. Actions: maya -> write postmortem, harry -> add tests & TTL guard, darin -> rotation verification.

maya: thanks all :heart: ping me if you need token ids or mount lists for the ticket.
